reviews.author: Varsha Venkatesan
reviews.text:
Team ASCAS with Dr Aishwarya and Dr Ashwin is a place any expecting family should go to for their pregnancy journey. You simply cannot be in safer hands.

Dr. Aishwarya is an extremely knowledgeable professional.

She handled both my pregnancies and it was an equally seamless and smooth journey in both the cases.

Her friendly and respectful demeanour makes her patients feel treated like her own family. She explains every milestone of pregnancy and makes us feel very much included in the journey.

Complementing her is Dr. Ashwin who clearly explained the outcomes of the scans and also cleared off doubts convincingly well.

The support staff and nurses of the clinic ensured the administrative aspects are made hassle free thereby faciliating the patients to focus on what really mattered.

My heartfelt gratitude to the team and I would DEFINITELY RECOMMEND the team to everyone.

reviews.text: I visited Dr Aishwarya Parthasarathy for a gynaecological issue and had an excellent  experience. She explained everything in detail which made me feel comfortable and reassured. reviews.author: Fin Care Associates
reviews.text: I had the pleasure of visiting Dr. Aishwarya for my gynecological needs, and I am so grateful for the exceptional care she provided. Dr. Aishwarya is not only incredibly knowledgeable and skilled, but she is also compassionate, understanding, and attentive to her patients' concerns. She took the time to listen to me, thoroughly explain all procedures and treatments, and made me feel comfortable throughout my appointments. Her professionalism and expertise instilled a great deal of trust in me, and I left each appointment feeling well taken care of. I highly recommend Dr. Aishwarya to anyone seeking an experienced and caring gynecologist.

reviews.author: Muthu Kumar
reviews.text: We always consider Aishwarya mam as one among our family member than a doctor. Despite her young age she carries immense professional expertise and her hands are capable of creating magics in fertility space. We have built a good connect during the course of our visits of my wife's first pregnancy. She is a person who carefully evaluates before committing something. While the first delivery was an emergency C section despite the efforts for a normal one which she clearly predicted in the previous scan reports as the head size was large. Normal delivery was a dream for us for the second one. Her words were so consistent and she had so much confidence on the stitches made by her in the previous c section. Though the entire labour had a rollercoaster of events she sat beside us with her excellent team and set up, she got the job done. No words to comprehend our gratitude!

reviews.author: Kasthuri Navya
reviews.text: I cannot express how grateful I am to Accumed Speciality Clinic and Scans and Dr Aishwarya Parthasarsthy. From the moment I stepped in, the staff was welcoming and understanding. The doctor took the time to explain every procedure, answering all my questions with patience. Their expertise was evident, and I felt confident in my treatment plan. After just a few cycles, I’m thrilled to say I’m pregnant! The support from the counseling team was invaluable, helping me navigate the emotional ups and downs of the journey. I highly recommend Accumed Speciality Clinic and Scans  to anyone looking for compassionate care and expertise in fertility treatments."

reviews.author: Karthikeyan
reviews.text:
We had been longing for a baby for the past five years, having gone through two heartbreaking losses mid-term, both at nearly five months. On our third attempt, our most precious princess finally arrived, and we owe it all to Dr. Aishwarya at Accumed Speciality.

Since our first pregnancy, we’ve been loyal believers in Dr. Aishwarya’s unique and thoughtful approach. Our case became a study on how to extend pregnancy successfully, and Dr. Aishwarya applied her knowledge and wisdom with incredible dedication. She didn't hesitate to collaborate with other gynecologists, constantly seeking advice and additional insights to help us succeed this time.

This pregnancy, too, was a roller coaster ride, but Dr. Aishwarya’s positivity and unwavering support were the driving forces that carried us through. Her availability, coupled with Accumed’s collective support, gave us the strength and confidence we needed throughout the journey.

One of the most invaluable things Dr. Aishwarya brings is her positivity. She always encourages you to stay positive and believe in the best, and that energy is contagious. We feel incredibly blessed to have been in her care, and her commitment to our success made all the difference.

If you are looking for a doctor who is not only skilled but also compassionate and dedicated to your well-being, I would highly recommend Dr. Aishwarya and Accumed Speciality.
